players.product: AI data-center colocation (Tydal, Norway: 121 IT MW leased to Volta for NVIDIA GPUs) and Bitdeer AI GPU cloud (NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 / Vera Rubin capacity in Malaysia, Norway and the US)

quarterly_data.signal: June 2026 operations update: executed a 5-year GPU cloud sales contract and completed customer deliveries following the deployment and production launch of 2 units of NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 clusters; GPUs under external subscription 3,517 (May: 3,305). Fox Creek, Alberta energization now expected in Q3 2027, with data center design accommodating both AI data center and crypto use; Wenatchee, Washington AI conversion completion targeted Q4 2026 to early 2027. Total global electrical capacity 3,025.2 MW including the 21.7 MW Johor Bahru, Malaysia lease. CFO Michael Potter: 'We also are encouraged by the interest being shown for our existing and planned AI Cloud services.'
quarterly_data.figure: 5-year GB300 GPU cloud contract; 3,517 GPUs under external subscription; 3,025.2 MW total capacity
